import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot with regression line
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', hue='BMI Category', style='Gender', palette='deep', s=100)

# Add a regression line
sns.regplot(data=data, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', scatter=False, color='black', line_kws={"linestyle":"--"})

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Sleep Duration vs. Quality of Sleep by BMI Category and Gender', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
plt.legend(title='BMI Category & Gender', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
